profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Managed 10+ engineers and oversaw a multitude of e-commerce projects, such as Google Store Trade-In program, Abuse platform, and next generation Content Management System; founded YouTube Monetization team from scratch to profitability; designed PayPal large merchant payment capability and successfully integrated with Dell as PayPal’s first large merchant.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Google Workspace Growth Core (2020 - Present), Tech Lead / Manager
* Google Workspace Signup and Onboarding
* Domain Registration

Google Store Content & Insights (2016 - 2020), Tech Lead / Manager
* Google Store Website
* Google Store Content Management System
* Google Store Abuse Platform 
* Built User Propensity Machine Learning Model 

Google Play Merchandising Platform (2013 - 2016), Tech Lead / Manager
* Built Google Play Merchandising Platform 
* Evolved Google Play Merchandising from human curation only into the next generation Machine Learning and Human Curation hybrid system

Google Offers (2011 - 2013), Tech Lead
* Google Offers Analysis and Search tool
* Built predictive model for Google Offers based on merchant quality and other signals

positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
* Participated in a 6-month Google Site Reliability rotation program
* Learned monitoring, alerting, and general production system best practice

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
YouTube Monetization, Tech Lead
* Founding Engineer of the team
* Led development of many YouTube Monetization projects
* Led the first YouTube project to partner with Google ML research: Featured Videos had 20+% increase in monetizable views at launch

YouTube Content Management
* Co-creator of AudioSwap
* Designed and implemented a partner management portal

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Merchant Services, Tech Lead
* Led design and implementation of second generation PayPal processing architecture, enhanced PayPal peer-to-peer payment transaction methodology with credit card like authorization and capture capability (C++, Apache, Oracle, XHTML, HTTP)
* Co-creator of eBay Gift Certificate and PayPal Merchant Gift Certificate
* Led successful integration with Dell as PayPal's first large merchant partner
* Led Yahoo Consumer Wallet integration phase 1
* Led design and implementation of merchant batch processing framework

positions.title: Tools Developer
positions.description:
Product Release Development
* Resolved multi-OS multi-DBMS customer reported issues (C++, Java, JavaScript, PeopleCode)
* Set a record for issues resolved by a new hire (50+ in a quarter)
* Specialized in localization and Computer Telephony Integration

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Inktomi Web Search
* Designed and implemented 500+ million URLs crawling and indexing system (C++, TCL)
* Designed and implemented TCP performance optimizer for wireless products (Java Swing, JCE)
* Designed and implemented unicast/multicast monitoring software for Inktomi wireless proxy cache

Inktomi Enterprise Search
* Designed and implemented unicode-compliant query lexer (XPath, XQuery)
* Designed and implemented garbage collector
* Designed and implemented customer facing Java API for Inktomi Search Toolkit
